From Spiderweb Stand · Price: it only works through existing spiderwebs.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: You sense through any web within 60 ft.
  • 5: Surge: a web binds a creature in it (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round.
  • 9: Move a creature's limbs through webs: it drops an item.
  • 13: Block speech through a web: the creature can't speak.
  • 17: Immobilized for 1 minute on a critical failure.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
